decisions.title: Astro with TypeScript for Static Generation
decisions.context: Need a high-performance, maintainable framework supporting thousands of markdown/MDX articles, schema-validated content collections, and zero-JS defaults for static deployment on GitHub Pages.
decisions.decision: Adopt Astro 5+ with TypeScript in static output mode. Avoid heavyweight SPA frameworks and server-side runtime dependencies.
decisions.consequences: Ultra-fast page loads, effortless GitHub Pages compatibility, strict type-checking on content frontmatter, zero hosting cost.

decisions.title: Vanilla CSS Design Tokens & Semantic Variables
decisions.context: Need a distinctive, editorial visual identity with rich dark/light themes, high contrast, and fine typographical control without framework churn.
decisions.decision: Implement custom CSS custom properties (design tokens) for color, typography, spacing, and elevation. Avoid utility-first CSS frameworks like Tailwind unless requested.
decisions.consequences: Zero build tool dependencies for styles, instant theme switching, highly maintainable and clean design system.

decisions.title: Local Client-Side Search Index over External Search APIs
decisions.context: Must satisfy the zero mandatory infrastructure expenditure constraint while providing instant search across articles, categories, and glossary terms.
decisions.decision: Generate static JSON search indices during build time and search client-side with lightweight tokenization. Partition index as corpus scales.
decisions.consequences: Completely free, runs entirely offline, private for the reader, zero API key exposure.

decisions.title: Three-Region Desktop Layout with Collapsible Sidebars
decisions.context: Long-form financial reading requires comfortable line length (68-75 chars) alongside rapid taxonomy navigation and deep table-of-contents jump points.
decisions.decision: Engineered a synchronized 3-column layout (Left: Collapsible Navigation, Center: Reading Container, Right: Sticky Table of Contents) on desktop, collapsing to a comfortable single column on mobile/tablet viewports.
decisions.consequences: Optimal readability, rapid navigation, keyboard-operable drawer states.

decisions.title: Decoupled Master Publication Build Artifacts
decisions.context: A master multi-million-word EPUB and PDF publication would exceed GitHub Pages 1GB recommended repository constraints if committed into the website asset tree.
decisions.decision: Isolate master book build artifacts into dedicated GitHub Releases workflows, linking downloads through lightweight CDN/release assets.
decisions.consequences: Maintains a lightweight web deployment bundle while preserving full book download accessibility.

decisions.title: Strict Statutory Evidence Hierarchy
decisions.context: Prevent hallucinated financial facts, unverified tax thresholds, and speculative marketing claims from corrupting the encyclopedia.
decisions.decision: Require all legal, tax, and product mechanisms to cite Tier 1 statutory authorities (RBI, SEBI, CBDT, PFRDA, IRDAI, EPFO, DICGC). Permit Tier 3 secondary sources solely for discovery.
decisions.consequences: Unimpeachable educational credibility, explicit tracking of research gaps where statutory ambiguity exists.

decisions.title: Expansion to 26 Canonical Domains (A through Z)
decisions.context: Prompt 002 required mapping the entire Indian financial system into a comprehensive 26-domain taxonomy covering personal finance, banking, payments, credit, taxation, real estate, commodities, derivatives, quant, forensics, and reference tools.
decisions.decision: Codify 26 canonical domains in `data/taxonomy/taxonomy.json` and `data/taxonomy/financial-system.json`, maintaining backward-compatible aliases for legacy Prompt 001 categories.
decisions.consequences: Standardized information architecture, comprehensive coverage of Indian financial infrastructure, zero broken URLs.

decisions.title: Audio-Native Continuous Prose and Spoken Mathematical Formulations
decisions.context: Complex equations and multi-column visual tables create severe comprehension barriers when rendered through screen readers or converted into text-to-speech audiobooks.
decisions.decision: Mandate that all substantive treatises structure calculations, statutory provisions, and compounding formulas into natural, flowing spoken English paragraphs without isolated LaTeX or ASCII formula barriers.
decisions.consequences: Effortless listening comprehension for audiobooks, universal accessibility, enhanced clarity of financial thought.

decisions.title: Substantive Treatises Scale Mandate Exceeding 10,000 Words
decisions.context: Superficial 1,000-word blog summaries fail to equip investors with deep operational understanding of complex legal, tax, and market mechanisms.
decisions.decision: Establish a policy that every foundational pillar article must be an exhaustive, technically rigorous treatise exceeding 10,000 words, validated by automated tests.
decisions.consequences: Definitive reference authority in Indian financial publishing, high educational value, deep long-term defensibility.

decisions.title: Explicit Real-World Shadow Economy and Forensic Finance Integration
decisions.context: Citizens encounter informal black money demands, real estate cash components ('on-money'), predatory unapproved loan apps, and dabba trading in everyday reality.
decisions.decision: Explicitly incorporate shadow economy mechanisms into Domain R, documenting circle rate gaps, Section 269SS/ST limits, Section 271D/DA 100% penalties, Benami Property Transactions Act confiscation, and SCRA dabba trading criminal sanctions.
decisions.consequences: Complete real-world relevance, practical citizen empowerment, rigorous legal and forensic honesty without moralizing.

decisions.title: Typed Directed Multigraph for Financial System Relationships
decisions.context: Financial products, statutory acts, regulators, risks, and calculators cannot be represented as isolated articles without loss of relational context and regulatory update traceability.
decisions.decision: Model the knowledge architecture as a typed directed multigraph in `data/knowledge-graph/nodes.json` and `relationships.json` using explicit predicates (governed_by, regulated_by, taxed_under, prohibits, mitigates_risk, exposes_to, has_calculator, requires_prerequisite).
decisions.consequences: Machine-readable dependency tracing, automated source-change impact cascades, clean referential integrity.

decisions.title: Multi-Tier Concept Explanations with Audio-Native Narration
decisions.context: Financial terms have differing levels of depth: beginners require intuitive intuition, while practitioners need precise statutory or mathematical definitions, and screen readers require spoken prose.
decisions.decision: Structure concept records in `data/concepts/concept-registry.json` with plain-English definitions, technical definitions, and spoken narrative formulas without raw equation blocks.
decisions.consequences: Universal accessibility, rapid comprehension across all skill levels, seamless text-to-speech rendering.

decisions.title: 4-Factor Risk-Weighted Prioritization for Research Gaps
decisions.context: With hundreds of potential financial topics, research prioritization must be objective and prevent life-altering consumer harm before niche topics are addressed.
decisions.decision: Adopt a 4-factor scoring formula: (Financial Harm x 0.35) + (Audience Reach x 0.25) + (Regulatory Sensitivity x 0.25) + (Content Urgency x 0.15) to segment research into P0 (critical blocker) through P4 (future research) bands.
decisions.consequences: Critical legal liabilities (e.g. Section 269SS/ST cash penalties, health insurance 3-year incontestability, dabba trading bans) are investigated and verified first.

decisions.title: Article Boundary Deduplication and Canonical Primary Home Policy
decisions.context: Mass content generation easily results in dozens of superficial articles repeating the same definitions and competing for identical search intent.
decisions.decision: Establish a canonical primary home rule in `reports/article-boundary-audit.md`: each foundational economic concept has one primary home; secondary articles must reference the canonical concept and provide unique decision-making value.
decisions.consequences: Zero keyword cannibalization, cohesive reference architecture, high editorial density across all publications.

decisions.title: Zero-Dependency Multi-Format Publishing Engine (EPUB 3.3 & PDF 1.4)
decisions.context: Standard eBook generation pipelines rely on heavy native binaries (Calibre, Pandoc) or headless browsers (Puppeteer, Playwright) which trigger frequent sandbox crashes, memory leaks, and version drift in CI runners.
decisions.decision: Construct custom pure Node.js byte-level compilers in scripts/generate-book.mjs: ZipBuilder for standards-compliant EPUB 3.3 (uncompressed mimetype 0x04034b50) and SimplePdfWriter for vector A4 PDF 1.4.
decisions.consequences: 100% reproducible builds, 0 external dependencies, builds in under 5 seconds on any Node 20+ runtime, zero cloud or API costs.

decisions.title: Moon+ Reader Pro Audio-Native Text-to-Speech (TTS) Mandate
decisions.context: Primary reader and listeners consume content as audiobooks with screens turned off via Android TTS. Visual equations and tables destroy listening comprehension.
decisions.decision: Mandate spoken English math formulas across all publications (zero raw LaTeX or $$ blocks in TTS text), enforce descriptive narrative paragraphs for all tables and Mermaid diagrams, and format Indian currency in spoken words.
decisions.consequences: Flawless listening comprehension in Moon+ Reader Pro, natural auditory pacing, accessible to both visually impaired readers and screen-off commuters.

decisions.title: 20-Section Master Operating Constitution with Specialist Policies
decisions.context: Autonomous AI agents operating in the repository require precise, testable, operational instructions rather than vague generic advice.
decisions.decision: Codify root AGENTS.md v4.0.0 spanning all 20 required sections and decompose deep operational rules into 7 modular specialist policies in docs/ (Research, Content, TTS, Publishing, Testing, Deployment, Versioning).
decisions.consequences: Consistent multi-agent behavior, clear source-of-truth hierarchy, zero ambiguity across coding, research, and publishing tasks.
